claims.statement: EBA loan-origination guidelines require robust creditworthiness assessment and lifecycle documentation, while ECB survey results show firms continue to apply for bank loans; this supports a recurring application event but not the claimed cost of poor preparation.
The proposed payer is the borrowing SME because it controls the application and experiences preparation delay; a 6000-18000 PLN readiness budget in Poland is unverified.

A nonexclusive accountant referral agreement plus direct SME opt-in can contract the application handoff without assuming ownership of adviser relationships, client lists, lender decisions, or financial records.
The product should prepare and reconcile evidence but must not promise approval or replace lender credit assessment.

commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Source-linked reconciliation, fast delivery, lender-neutral portability, and a reusable annual room must outperform a one-off spreadsheet bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Referral partner owns its advisory relationship; founder company owns the separately opted-in readiness engagement
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accountants, fractional CFOs, finance advisers, and direct application-readiness content

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Partner referral fee or founder-led outbound; target covered within the fixed project fee
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Fifty percent upfront and balance on delivery; no success fee tied to lender approval during initial model
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Target 45-65% after a sector template stabilizes; bespoke cleanup can erase margin
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Record reconciliation, client interviews, forecast normalization, query tracking, and handoff
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: GDPR/security, professional insurance, AML boundary review, contracts, and secure deletion
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Hypothesis: 6000-18000 PLN per readiness room plus 500-1500 PLN for later refreshes
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Secure storage, extraction, model use, e-signature, and specialist review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Accountants, brokers, lenders, and virtual-CFO firms can bundle application packaging with existing services
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A loan application or refinancing is a discrete financing event; incomplete or inconsistent records can create rework, delay, or rejection, though causality must be measured
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Planned borrowing, lender request list, covenant reset, refinancing deadline, or prior application friction
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Each new facility, refinancing, material expansion, or annual lender review

contrary_evidence: Accountants and finance brokers already package records and may bundle the work into broader fees.
EBA guidance governs lenders and does not prove SMEs will pay a third party for readiness.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Nonexclusive 12-month referral and workflow-integration agreement plus a direct scoped service and data-processing contract with each SME
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Recruit other accountants or sell direct to SMEs; never use adviser client lists or records without permission
critical_control_point.current_owner: Each accounting or advisory firm owns its client relationship; the SME owns its records and financing decision
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Referral partner owns its advisory relationship; founder company owns the separately opted-in readiness engagement
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No accountant, lender, or SME relationship is currently controlled. Access must be earned through ordinary partner and direct-client contracts with explicit record permissions.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Referring firm and SME must each opt in before the founder company receives records or begins work
critical_control_point.renewal: Annual partner renewal; each SME engagement ends after delivery and retention period
critical_control_point.subject: Referral and workflow handoff when an accounting client begins a financing application

economics.acquisition_route: Nonexclusive accountant and fractional-CFO referrals plus direct SME outreach
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Illustrative, not forecast: 1200 rooms annually at a 10000 PLN blended fee imply 12m PLN revenue; a 5m PLN founder outcome requires channel replication, standardized delivery, and delegated analysts
economics.founder_time: Maximum five hours daily with strict intake gates and no bespoke bookkeeping or loan brokerage
economics.gross_margin_basis: Standardized extraction, reconciliation, and source-linked templates with bounded expert review
economics.payback: Upfront deposit should cover CAC and intake; unvalidated
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 6000-18000 PLN per readiness room plus 500-1500 PLN per refresh
economics.retention_or_repeat: New facilities, refinancing, covenant resets, and annual lender reviews

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned, de-identified missing-document and lender-query patterns improve templates by sector and facility type
fingerprint.customer: Polish owner-managed SMEs applying for or refinancing bank and nonbank credit
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Nonexclusive referral and workflow agreements with accountants, fractional CFOs, and finance advisers, followed by direct SME opt-in
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Source-linked normalization, document checklist, reconciled forecast pack, lender-question tracker, and permissioned data room sold per financing event
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The SME pays a fixed fee when a standardized lender-readiness room is delivered
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An SME decides to seek financing and must assemble reliable financial, ownership, debt, forecast, and supporting records for lender assessment

founder_fit: Financial normalization and data-quality checks match business-analysis and data-science skills
The deliverable has bounded scope and a clear transaction trigger
Partner-led distribution avoids constant public promotion
Template reuse and secure automation can keep delivery within a five-hour daily founder limit
risks: Clients may interpret preparation as an approval guarantee
Sensitive financial records create security exposure
Messy source accounts can turn a fixed-scope product into consulting

structure.control_point: Contractible accountant-to-client handoff at the start of a financing application
structure.critical_dependency: Trusted referring advisers and timely, accurate client records

thesis: Contract a referral and workflow handoff with accounting firms at the moment a client plans borrowing, then sell the SME a fixed-scope, lender-ready financial data room and query log without brokering or deciding credit.
title: Accountant-Triggered SME Loan Readiness Room
uncertainties: Most common lender requests by Polish SME segment and facility type
Incremental approval speed or query reduction from standardized preparation
Accountant referral economics and conflict concerns
Level of bespoke forecast work needed per client
